newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld sets one-for-three rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld sets one-for-three rights offer.

text.p: Megaworld Properties and Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board had approved a one-for-three rights offer at four pesos per share.
Vice president Cirilo Manlangit said in a statement the record date for the rights had not yet been fixed.
Manlangit said proceeds from the offering would be used to finance forthcoming projects.

"The offering will send a strong and positive signal to the market about our confidence in the long-term prospects of the Philippine property market and of the dominant role we intend to play in the sector," he added.
Sun Hung Kai Capital Philippines Inc was appointed issue manager and lead underwriter of the issue.
Megaworld ended up 10 centavos at 6.90 pesos on Tuesday.
